decisions.reason: The Definition correctly permits state-dependent action sets, so a common-action full matrix Q^a is undefined. This is a nonfatal defect confined to Remarks. Define p^a_ij=delta_ij+q^a_ij/lambda rowwise: q^a_ii=-sum_{j!=i}q^a_ij ensures positivity and row sum one, and moving -lambda V_i outside the maximum gives exactly the displayed discounted equation. The Definition, finite-choice convention, contract and page interfaces are unchanged.

F3 (Bolzano-Weierstrass) and F4 (compact extreme values) explicitly require n>=1, whereas this lemma also covers R^0. The original proof does not discharge that boundary case. Added a direct check: a nonempty U in R^0 is {0}, its subdifferential is {0}, H(0)=f(0), F*(0)=-f(0), and g=0; the empty-domain assertions are vacuous. The existing directional-slope, support localization, coercive minimization, and conjugate sandwich arguments then apply with n>=1. The Statement and AC assumption are unchanged.

Differentiability controls g(p_i+h)-g(p_i)-Dg(p_i)h, so the original unshifted tube inclusion in step 1.2 is false even for a nonzero constant map. Replaced it with the affine image g(p_i)+Dg(p_i)B(0,5r_i) and centered the adapted orthonormal coordinates at g(p_i). Translated small boxes still fit in axis-parallel cubes of side O_n(epsilon r_i); the rank q<=n-1 count and total volume O_n(epsilon(L+1)^(n-1)r_i^n) remain valid. Disjoint-ball volume summability and countable cube covers complete the unchanged null-image conclusion, including n=1, L=0 and rank zero.

The alleged reverse implication is definitional, not an inference from completeness: thm-lebesgue-measure-is-a-complete-measure Facts L1 explicitly states lambda_n=lambda_n* restricted to the measurable sets, citing def-lebesgue-measure-and-the-lebesgue-sigma-algebra. Thus a measurable lambda-null exceptional set has outer measure zero, and the already-declared null-equivalence theorem converts it to a cube-cover-null set. Checked ACL weak gradients, rational strong-Lebesgue-point reduction, Poincare oscillation, both Lipschitz-volume contradictions and countable localization under the declared AC assumption. No item edit is needed.

The separate result thm-na-howard-policy-iteration-monotone-improvement-termination is listed later on the same home page. Its complete proof shows a nonnegative residual strict at switched states, inverse-positive policy evaluation with positive diagonal, strict value increase, nonrecurrence among P policies, and terminal Bellman optimality and uniqueness. Thus the algorithm phrase "the theorem below" has an actual proved referent; no proof belongs inside this procedure Definition. The procedure has finite deterministic ties, exact well-defined solves, convergence tested before exhaustion, and a sufficient P-evaluation budget.

Monotonicity is proved separately in lem-na-diagonal-diffusion-stencil-is-monotone, listed later on the same home page. Its proof expands the sign-dependent neighbor weights tau(alpha/h^2-|b|/h) and tau alpha/h^2, checks the center coefficient 1-tau sum(2alpha/h^2-|b|/h), and proves nonnegativity and row sum one under the two algorithm guards. Taking the finite maximum preserves order. The algorithm correctly supplies the recurrence, coefficient evaluation times, initialization, admissibility conditions and final array; its title does not require a duplicate proof inside the Definition. Corrected a separate contract boundary sentence that allowed zero diffusion despite the inherited alpha>=alpha_*>0 hypothesis. The item guard is unchanged; this is a metadata-only repair.
